sampling_decisions: Source waveform contains one paired burst near 50/70 ms and a later distinct paired burst near 130/146 ms.
Selected only the first clean paired burst, preserving its natural down/up click texture and useful decay.
Trimmed the source to 43–123 ms, before the later separate burst, to avoid playing two clicks for one action.
Applied a neutral stereo-to-mono downmix, resampled from 44.1 kHz to 22.05 kHz, and matched peak to 0.42.
Applied a 0.4 ms attack fade and 8 ms tail fade; no pitch change, time stretching, or synthetic click was introduced.
